sources.title: Trident: How a 7B Language Model Broke Every AI Cyber Defense It Was ...
sources.snippet: A language model with 7 billion parameters, trained on two GPUs, autonomously learned to detect and avoid decoy services deployed by AI cyber defenders. Nobody told it the decoys existed. The model figured it out on its own, implementing a threshold mechanism to abort attacks against suspicious hosts after repeated failures.

sources.title: Seaweed-7B: Cost-Effective Training of Video Generation Foundation Model
sources.snippet: This technical report discusses a cost-efficient strategy for training a video generation foundation model. We choose to train a moderately sized model with FLOPs optimized for deployment on a single GPU, namely Seaweed-7B (short for Seed Video), which consists of a DiT with approximately 7 billion parameters.
